scope: Read-only scan of all 41 current compiled component PDFs plus the Paper III analytic source title line. Only this JSON report was written. Exact frozen readers/attachments and scientific material were not changed.
method: Case-insensitive alphabetic normalization per extracted text line, ignoring whitespace, tracking spaces and punctuation; phrase rectangles use actual character boxes. An independent whole-page alphabetic scan found the same six affected components.

recommended_bounded_changes.reason: The phrase is a literal title-line string after begin{document}; replacing this one editorial string is safer than intercepting shared text/color macros. A macro adapter would still require touching this title call. Leave all mathematical text, author, historical dates and versions unchanged for this bounded branding operation.
recommended_bounded_changes.validation: Review one exact source hunk; recompile analytic only; compare all non-branding source bytes; require page count and non-branding PDF text unchanged; inspect title page.

recommended_bounded_changes.reason: Exact selected editable sources are not part of the rebuild route. Keep frozen_readers and embedded originals byte-identical. Create separate display derivatives for the five components and record the editorial change explicitly.
recommended_bounded_changes.edits: Replace only the mapped branding line or phrase. For combined OPERATION KOMOREBI / REALIZATION CALCULUS or middle-dot lines, replace the whole branding line with REALIZATION CALCULUS to avoid duplication. For Paper III release-record footers, preserve the PAPER III / RELEASE 1.0.0 suffix; dates/versions in historical text are outside this bounded scan.
recommended_bounded_changes.font_handling: Helvetica/Helvetica-Bold lines can use the corresponding base PDF font. NimbusSans and older NimbusSanL lines should use an explicitly identified installed regular/bold Nimbus Sans face with recorded hash. Do not assume a subset font contains the new L/Z/C/U/S glyphs. Preserve original size, color, baseline and alignment where the replacement fits; check adjacent text before expanding a rectangle.
recommended_bounded_changes.precise_pdf_operation: Use tightly mapped text-only redaction/character removal with image and vector removal disabled, then insert the replacement. Do not cover old text with white rectangles alone: that leaves stale extractable/searchable branding. No blanket margin crop, no broad text regex replacement in raw content streams, and no full-page rasterization.
recommended_bounded_changes.validation: For each affected page, preserve page geometry/labels/links and compare extracted non-branding text. Render before/after and require pixels outside the union of old/new branding regions to match (allow only antialiasing tolerance if demonstrably needed). Check mathematical/vector/image content independently; render every altered cover and representative repeated header/footer layouts. Confirm no Operation Komorebi remains in display PDFs while exact attachment hashes remain unchanged.

provenance_note: After editing, the five display derivatives must no longer be described as byte-identical original facsimile components. Their scientific page content can be described as preserved with an explicitly recorded branding-only editorial treatment; original attachments remain exact.
